blockers.detail: webhook trigger linear/LINEAR_ISSUE_CREATED_TRIGGER needs webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId

setup: "Linear Trigger": after import, register the linear webhook (`cdecli webhook endpoint create -c linear`, then `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug LINEAR_ISSUE_CREATED_TRIGGER`) and set webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId on the trigger node.
Workflow secret LINEAR_API_KEY: Linear API key for api.linear.app (Authorization: <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: "Linear Trigger" is a provider webhook (linear/LINEAR_ISSUE_CREATED_TRIGGER). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c linear --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug LINEAR_ISSUE_CREATED_TRIGGER --account <connectedAccountId>`.
"Get all linear teams" authenticated with linearOAuth2Api in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Merge data" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was chooseBranch).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect linear: `cdecli credential create -n "linear" -p linear --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect slack: `cdecli credential create -n "slack" -p slack --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
### When does this fire?
In our setup we have a general team in Linear where we post new tickets to. Additionally, the bug needs to have a certain label and the description needs to be filled. 
You're of course free to adjust this to your needs
👇

## Setup
1. Add your Linear and OpenAi credentials
2. Change the team in the `Linear Trigger` to match your needs
3. Customize your teams and their areas of responsibility in the `Set me up` node. Please use the format `[Teamname][Description/Areas of responsibility]`. Also make sure that the teamnames match the names in Linear exactly.
4. Change the Slack channel in the `Set me up` node to your Slack channel of choice.
